content.title: Easter Sunday is April 20: What stores and restaurants will be open?
content.text: When is Easter?The question arises annually because the Christian holiday does not fall on the same date every year."The simplest way to explain the date of Easter is that it falls on the first Sunday after the full moon that follows the spring equinox," which is the beginning of spring in the Northern Hemisphere, according to USA Today.This year, Sunday, April 20 is the big day.The next annual Easter-related question is ― what's open?Easter is not a federal holiday, but since it is on a Sunday, government offices, banks, post offices and many other places are usually closed anyway.Good Friday is also not a federal holiday. But it is a holiday for Florida state government, as well as for county government offices in Clay, Nassau County, Putnam and St. Johns counties. Public schools are closed that day in Clay, Duval, Putnam and St. Johns counties, but open in Baker and Nassau counties.Jacksonville city offices will be open, as will most stores and restaurants.Here's a roundup of Easter Sunday closings:Easter events: Easter is April 20. Here's a guide to egg hunts and parades in the Jacksonville areaIs Publix open on Easter?No. Easter is one of three holidays that prompt Publix to close. The others are Thanksgiving and Christmas Day.Is Target open on Easter?No. Target is closed on Easter.Are Walmart and Kroger open on Easter?Yes, but Kroger hours may vary by location.Are Winn-Dixie and Harveys open on Easter?Yes, Winn-Dixie and Harveys Supermarket are open, but hours may vary by location.Are Costco, Sam's Club or BJ's Wholesale Clubs open on Easter?Costco and Sam's Club warehouses will be closed. BJ's will be open, but hours may vary location.Are Lowe's and Home Depot open on Easter?Lowe's will be closed, Home Depot stores will be open 8 a.m. to 6 p.m.Are Academy Sports + Outdoors and Dick's Sporting Goods be open on Easter?Academy Sports + Outdoors will be open. Dick's will be closed.Are Aldi and Trader Joe's open on Easter?Aldi will be closed. Trader Joe's will be open.Are The Fresh Market and Whole Foods open on Easter?Yes, but Whole Foods hours may vary by location.Are Petco and PetSmart open on Easter?Yes, Petco stores will be open regular hours; PetSmart stores will be open from 11 a.m. to 6 p.m.Will CVS and Walgreens be open on Easter?Yes, CVS and Walgreens are open, but hours may vary by location.Are McDonald's and Burger King open on Easter?Yes, McDonald's and Burger King are open, but hours may vary by location.Are Chick-fil-A and Wendy's open on Easter?No for Chick-fil-A, since it is always closed on Sundays. Wendy's will be open, but hours may vary by location.Are Arby's and Hardee's open on Easter?Arby's will be closed, Hardee's will be open on Easter.Are Chipotle and Taco Bell open on Easter?Chipotle will be closed on Easter. Taco Bell will be open, but hours vary by location.Are Cracker Barrel and Golden Corral open on Easter?Yes, Cracker Barrel and Golden Corral are open.Are Applebee's and IHOP open on Easter?Yes, Applebee's and IHOP are open, but hours may vary by location.Are Olive Garden and Texas Roadhouse open on Easter?Yes, Olive Garden and Texas Roadhouse are open, but hours may vary by location.Are Subway and Firehouse Subs open on Easter?Subway will be open but hours may vary by location. Firehouse Subs will be closed.Are Jersey Mike's and Jimmy Johns open on Easter?Yes, Jersey Mike's and Jimmy Johns are open, but hours may vary by location.Are Krispy Kreme and Dunkin' open on Easter?Yes, but Dunkin' hours may vary by location.Are Starbucks and Panera open on Easter?Yes, Starbucks and Panera are open, but hours may vary by location.bcravey@jacksonville.com, (904) 359-4109USA Today contributed to this report.This article originally appeared on Florida Times-Union: Publix, Target closed on Easter.
